name: Yangshao Caitaofang
verdict: Baijiu brand of Henan Yangshao Liquor Industry, controlled by founder Hou Jianguang (65.91%); all shareholders natural persons. Nothing found.
note: Front-of-shirt and naming-rights sponsor of Henan FC for the 2026 Chinese Super League season; the naming deal was signed 4 March 2026 and the club competes as 'Henan FC Caitaofang' (Soccer News via Tencent News, 2026-03-09; Dahe Finance Cube, 2026-03-05). Rating note: Henan Yangshao Liquor Industry Co., Ltd. is a private baijiu maker in Mianchi County, Henan, formed from a restructured former state-owned distillery; company data cited in press show founder Hou Jianguang holding 65.91% and all other shareholders natural persons, so no state or fund reaches the sponsor. No human-rights finding against the company found. Proposed 'none'.
